comment: Stop (S) on a Reaver while a Scarab is in flight and on a Carrier while its Interceptors are out: the console sends ExecReaverStop (command 0x1c, ReaverStop 7 0x41c910: the Scarab launched at frame 133 destroys itself, SelfDestructing 165 0x42a4d0) and ExecCarrierStop (command 0x1b, CarrierStop 52: the Interceptors return); both parents keep their target. The commands, ReaverStop and SelfDestructing were unported before this scenario.
